course.title: Muscle Building
course.tagline: Build muscle with training, food and rest, and track real progress.

days.title: How muscles grow
days.goal: Learn the simple idea behind building muscle.

video.title: ULTIMATE beginners guide to building muscle // With FULL gym plan

steps: Watch the video and write the main idea in one sentence.
Learn this: muscles grow when you train them hard, then rest and eat well.
Write down 3 things muscles need: training, protein, sleep.
Set one small goal for the month.
days.task: Write 3 things muscles need to grow.
days.challenge: Explain muscle growth to a friend in one sentence.

quiz.q: What do muscles need to grow?
options: Hard training, protein food and rest
quiz.explain: Training, protein and rest work together.
Training breaks muscle down; rest rebuilds it stronger.

quiz.q: What is a good first goal?
options: Train every day with no rest
Train 3 times a week for a month
quiz.explain: Three times a week is a safe, steady start.

days.title: Learn the 5 big moves
days.goal: Learn the 5 moves that build the whole body.

video.title: Beginner Gym Guide: A Complete Step-by-Step Plan to Build Muscle

steps: The 5 moves are: squat, push-up, row, hip hinge, plank.
Try each move once with light effort.
Write down which move felt hardest.
Practise the hardest move for 5 minutes.
days.task: Try all 5 big moves once today.
days.challenge: Name the 5 big moves from memory.

options: Squat, push-up, row, hip hinge, plank
quiz.explain: The five moves cover the whole body.

options: They work many muscles at once
quiz.explain: Big moves build the most strength.

quiz.q: What should you do with the hardest move?
quiz.explain: Slow practice turns a hard move into an easy one.

days.title: The squat: your leg builder
days.goal: Learn a strong squat with good form.

video.title: The PERFECT Beginner Workout

steps: Stand with feet a little wider than your hips.
Push your hips back like sitting in a chair.
Keep your chest up and knees with your toes.
Stand up by pressing through your whole foot.
days.task: Do 3 sets of 8 slow squats.
days.challenge: Hold the bottom of a squat for 3 seconds, 5 times.

options: The same way as your toes
quiz.explain: Knees following the toes keeps the knee safe.
A tall chest keeps your back safe.
Pressing through the foot gives a strong stand.

days.title: The push-up: your chest builder
days.goal: Learn a push-up that builds chest, shoulders and arms.

video.title: How To Build Muscle (Explained In 5 Levels)

steps: Start with a wall push-up, then try a knee push-up.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Lower down for 2 seconds, push up in 1 second.
Breathe out as you push up.
days.task: Do 3 sets of 5 knee push-ups.
days.challenge: Try one full push-up from your toes.

quiz.q: What should your body look like?
options: One straight line from head to knees or toes
quiz.explain: A straight line keeps the back safe.

quiz.q: How fast should you lower down?
quiz.explain: A slow lower works the muscle more.
Breathing out on the push keeps you steady.

days.title: The row: your back builder
days.goal: Learn a row that builds your back and arms.

video.title: How To Lose MORE Fat And KEEP/BUILD Muscle

steps: Try a table row: hold a sturdy table edge, pull your chest up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower down slowly for 2 seconds.
Keep your body straight the whole time.
days.task: Do 3 sets of 8 table rows.
days.challenge: Hold the top of a row for 2 seconds, 5 times.

quiz.explain: Rows build the pulling muscles of the back.

quiz.q: What should you squeeze at the top?
quiz.explain: Squeezing the shoulder blades works the back.
A slow lower builds more muscle.

days.title: Protein: food that builds muscle
days.goal: Learn how much protein you need and where to get it.

video.title: Push-up variations for chest growth

steps: Learn this: aim for protein at every meal.
List 5 protein foods: eggs, beans, fish, chicken, yoghurt.
Add one protein food to each meal today.
Write down what you ate and its protein.
days.task: Add protein to every meal today.
days.challenge: List 5 protein foods you can buy locally.

quiz.explain: Protein is the building material for muscle.
Protein at every meal helps muscles repair all day.

quiz.q: What is a cheap protein food?
quiz.explain: Eggs and beans are cheap and full of protein.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 1: Your first full-body workout
days.goal: Put week 1 together: build your first full-body muscle workout.

video.title: Follow-along leg workout with dumbbells

steps: Pick 5 moves: squat, push-up, row, hip hinge, plank.
Write 2 sets of 8 to 10 reps for each move.
Add a warm-up at the start.
Do the workout and write down your numbers.
days.task: Do your full-body workout and record your reps.
days.challenge: Do the workout again in 2 days.

quiz.q: What should a full-body workout have?
options: Moves for legs, push, pull and core
quiz.explain: A full-body workout trains everything.

quiz.q: How many sets suit a beginner?
quiz.explain: Two sets is enough to learn and grow.
Written reps show your progress.

project.title: Your first full-body workout
project.brief: Build your first full-body muscle workout with the 5 big moves, 2 sets of each, a warm-up, and record your reps.

days.title: Rest days build muscle
days.goal: Learn why rest is when muscles grow.

video.title: 10 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT 🔥 For Beginners | No Equipment

steps: Train 3 days this week and rest on the other days.
On rest days, walk gently or stretch.
Sleep 7 to 9 hours each night.
Write down how your muscles feel after rest.
days.task: Take a rest day today and walk for 10 minutes.
days.challenge: Sleep 8 hours tonight.

quiz.explain: Rest is when the body repairs and builds muscle.

quiz.q: How many rest days should a beginner have?
options: At least 2 to 3 days a week
quiz.explain: Rest days let muscles repair.

quiz.q: What should you do on a rest day?
quiz.explain: Gentle movement helps recovery.

days.title: Progressive overload, simply
days.goal: Learn the key rule: do a little more over time.

video.title: HWC Beginner Hypertrophy

steps: Progressive overload means adding a little more each week.
Add 1 rep to one move this week.
Add 1 set to another move next week.
Write down your numbers so you can see the adds.
days.task: Add 1 rep to your squats today.
days.challenge: Add 1 rep to every move this week.

options: Doing a little more over time
quiz.explain: Small adds over time build muscle.

quiz.q: How much should you add each week?
quiz.explain: Small adds are safe and steady.

options: So you know what to add next
quiz.explain: Written numbers guide your progress.

days.title: Train your legs: lunges and hinges
days.goal: Add lunges and hip hinges for stronger legs.

video.title: How to Build Muscle as a Beginner | Complete Gym Guide

steps: Try a lunge: step forward, bend both knees, step back.
Try a hip hinge: push hips back, keep back flat, stand up.
Do 6 lunges per leg and 10 hip hinges.
Keep your back flat during the hinge.
days.task: Do 3 sets of 6 lunges per leg.
days.challenge: Do 10 hip hinges with a flat back.

options: Pushing your hips back with a flat back
quiz.explain: A hinge trains the back of the legs.

quiz.q: What should your back do in a hinge?
quiz.explain: A flat back keeps the hinge safe.
Lunges build leg strength and balance.

days.title: Train your shoulders
days.goal: Learn safe shoulder moves for a strong upper body.

video.title: How to build an amazing physique

steps: Try a pike push-up: hips high, bend elbows, push up.
Try a light dumbbell press if you have weights.
Do 2 sets of 8 reps.
Keep your neck relaxed and breathe normally.
days.task: Do 2 sets of 8 pike push-ups.
days.challenge: Hold a plank for 20 seconds, 3 times.

options: A push-up with hips high in the air
quiz.explain: A pike push-up trains the shoulders.
A relaxed neck keeps the move safe.

quiz.q: How many sets suit a beginner?
quiz.explain: Two sets is enough to learn.

days.title: Eat to build muscle
days.goal: Learn how to eat a little more to grow.

video.title: Push-ups for chest growth

steps: To build muscle, eat a little more than usual.
Add one extra healthy snack a day.
Eat protein at every meal.
Drink water through the day.
days.task: Add one healthy snack today.
days.challenge: Eat protein at every meal this week.

quiz.q: Why eat a little more to build muscle?
options: Muscles need extra energy to grow
Eating more makes you fat only
quiz.explain: A small extra gives the body fuel to build.

quiz.q: What is a good muscle snack?
quiz.explain: Protein snacks help muscles repair.

options: Water helps muscles work and recover
quiz.explain: Water keeps muscles working well.

days.title: Track your progress
days.goal: Learn to track reps, weight and body size.

video.title: The Ultimate No-Gym Workout for Skinny Guys (Build Muscle at Home)

steps: Write down your reps for every move this week.
Measure your arms and chest with a tape.
Take a photo of yourself from the front.
Compare your numbers with last week.
days.task: Record your reps and measurements today.
days.challenge: Compare with last week's numbers.

options: So you know when to add more
quiz.explain: Tracking shows real progress.

quiz.q: What should you measure besides reps?
quiz.explain: Body measures show muscle growth.
Weekly checks show the trend.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 2: Your 4-day split
days.goal: Put week 2 together: split your training across 4 days.

video.title: Beginner Workout - Start Here If You Haven't Exercised in Years (Women Over 40)

steps: Day 1: legs. Day 2: push. Day 3: rest. Day 4: pull. Day 5: legs and core.
Write 3 moves for each day.
Do the split this week.
Write down your numbers each day.
days.task: Write your 4-day split and start it.
days.challenge: Finish all 4 training days this week.

options: Training different body parts on different days
quiz.explain: A split spreads work across the week.

options: Each part gets full effort and rest
quiz.explain: Splits let each muscle work hard then rest.

quiz.q: How many moves per day suit a beginner?
quiz.explain: Three moves is enough for a good session.

project.title: Your 4-day split
project.brief: Split training across 4 days: legs, push, pull, legs and core, with 3 moves per day, and record your numbers.

days.title: Train your arms
days.goal: Learn simple arm moves for bigger arms.

video.title: The Foundational Beginner Workout Plan to Build Muscle - Day One: Legs and Intervals

steps: Try a chair dip for the back of the arms.
Try a dumbbell curl if you have weights, or a water bottle curl.
Do 2 sets of 10 reps of each.
Move slowly and squeeze at the top.
days.task: Do 2 sets of 10 chair dips and 10 curls.
days.challenge: Hold a curl at the top for 2 seconds.

options: Hands on a chair, bend elbows to lower the body
quiz.explain: A chair dip trains the back of the arms.

options: Bending the elbow to lift a weight to the shoulder
quiz.explain: A curl trains the front of the arms.

quiz.q: How should you lift a curl?
options: Slowly, with a squeeze at the top
quiz.explain: Slow curls work the muscle more.

days.title: Train your chest more
days.goal: Add push-up versions to grow your chest.

video.title: The Foundational Beginner Workout Plan to Build Muscle - Day Two: Shoulders and Abs

steps: Try a wide push-up: hands wider than shoulders.
Try an incline push-up: hands on a table.
Do 2 sets of 8 reps of each.
Keep your body straight the whole time.
days.task: Do 2 sets of 8 wide push-ups.
days.challenge: Do 2 sets of 8 incline push-ups.

quiz.q: What does a wide push-up train?
quiz.explain: Wide push-ups work the chest more.

options: Hands on a raised surface like a table
quiz.explain: Incline push-ups are easier and build strength.

quiz.q: What should your body do in a push-up?
quiz.explain: A straight line keeps the push-up safe.

days.title: Train your back more
days.goal: Add row versions to grow your back.

video.title: The Foundational Beginner Workout Plan to Build Muscle - Day Three: Chest and Triceps

steps: Try a one-arm row with a water bottle or dumbbell.
Pull the weight to your hip, squeeze, lower slowly.
Do 2 sets of 10 reps per arm.
Keep your back flat the whole time.
days.task: Do 2 sets of 10 one-arm rows per arm.
days.challenge: Hold the top of a row for 2 seconds.

options: Pulling a weight to your hip with one arm
quiz.explain: A one-arm row trains the back and arms.

quiz.q: Where should you pull the weight?
quiz.explain: Pulling to the hip works the back best.
A flat back keeps the row safe.

days.title: Sleep for muscle growth
days.goal: Learn why sleep is a muscle builder.

video.title: The Foundational Beginner Workout Plan to Build Muscle - Day Four: Back and Biceps

steps: Sleep 7 to 9 hours tonight.
Go to bed at the same time each night.
Keep your room dark and cool.
Write down how strong you felt after good sleep.
days.task: Sleep 8 hours tonight.
days.challenge: Keep the same bedtime for 3 nights.

options: The body repairs muscle while you sleep
quiz.explain: Deep sleep is when repair happens.

quiz.q: How much sleep should you aim for?
quiz.explain: Seven to nine hours helps muscle repair.

options: A dark, cool room and a set bedtime
quiz.explain: A dark, cool room helps deep sleep.

days.title: Fix your form: common mistakes
days.goal: Learn the 3 most common muscle-building mistakes.

video.title: ULTIMATE beginners guide to building muscle // With FULL gym plan

steps: Mistake 1: lifting too heavy with bad form. Fix: go lighter.
Mistake 2: rushing reps. Fix: slow down to 2 seconds.
Mistake 3: skipping legs. Fix: train legs every week.
Pick one mistake and fix it today.
days.task: Pick one mistake and fix it today.
days.challenge: Teach a friend the 3 mistakes.

quiz.q: Why is lifting too heavy a mistake?
options: Bad form can hurt you and works the wrong muscles
quiz.explain: Lighter weight with good form builds more.

options: Slow reps work the muscle more
quiz.explain: Slow, controlled reps build strength safely.

options: Legs are half your body and drive growth
quiz.explain: Training legs builds the whole body.

days.title: Build a home gym, cheap
days.goal: Learn the few tools that build muscle at home.

video.title: Beginner Gym Guide: A Complete Step-by-Step Plan to Build Muscle

steps: You need: a mat, water bottles or dumbbells, a sturdy chair.
A backpack with books works as a weight.
A resistance band adds pull to moves.
Write your home gym list and gather the tools.
days.task: Gather your home gym tools today.
days.challenge: Try a backpack squat with books inside.

quiz.q: What do you need for a home gym?
options: A mat, weights and a sturdy chair
quiz.explain: Simple tools are enough to build muscle.

options: Work as a weight for squats
quiz.explain: A heavy backpack adds load to moves.

quiz.q: What does a resistance band do?
options: Adds pull to make moves harder
quiz.explain: A band adds resistance to any move.

days.title: PROJECT WEEK 3: Your 4-week muscle plan
days.goal: Put week 3 together: write a 4-week muscle plan.

video.title: The PERFECT Beginner Workout

steps: Write 4 weeks of training: 3 to 4 days a week.
Make each week a little harder: add 1 rep or 1 set.
Add protein notes and sleep notes to the plan.
Start week 1 of your plan.
days.task: Write your 4-week plan.
days.challenge: Start week 1 today.

quiz.explain: Three to four times gives growth and rest.

quiz.q: How do you make each week harder?
quiz.explain: Small adds keep progress safe.

quiz.q: What else should your plan have?
quiz.explain: Food and sleep are part of muscle growth.

project.title: Your 4-week muscle plan
project.brief: Write a 4-week muscle plan with 3 to 4 training days a week, small weekly progress, protein notes and sleep notes.
checks: Each week is a little harder
Training is 3 to 4 days a week

days.title: Test your strength
days.goal: Test how much stronger you have become.

video.title: How To Build Muscle (Explained In 5 Levels)

steps: Count your max squats with good form.
Count your max push-ups with good form.
Time your longest plank.
Write all three numbers down.
days.task: Record your 3 test numbers today.
days.challenge: Beat one number next week.

options: To see how much you have grown
quiz.explain: Tests show progress in numbers.

quiz.q: What matters most in a test?
quiz.explain: Good form shows true strength.
A few weeks apart shows real change.

days.title: Deload: train lighter for a week
days.goal: Learn what a deload is and why it helps.

video.title: How To Lose MORE Fat And KEEP/BUILD Muscle

steps: A deload means training lighter for one week.
Do half the sets and lighter weights this week.
Focus on perfect form.
Notice how fresh you feel after.
days.task: Do a light week: half the sets, perfect form.
days.challenge: Write down how you felt after the light week.

options: A lighter training week to recover
quiz.explain: A deload lets the body catch up and recover.

options: It lets tired muscles fully recover
quiz.explain: Light weeks prevent burnout and injury.

quiz.q: What should you focus on during a deload?
quiz.explain: Form work during a light week pays off later.

days.title: Eat for your goal: bulk or lean
days.goal: Learn the difference between building size and staying lean.

video.title: Push-up variations for chest growth

steps: To gain size, eat a little more. To stay lean, eat a little less.
Pick your goal and write it down.
Adjust one snack up or down to match your goal.
Check your weight once a week.
days.task: Write your goal: gain size or stay lean.
days.challenge: Adjust one snack to match your goal.

options: Eating a little more to gain size
quiz.explain: Bulking means a small food extra to grow.

options: Keeping body fat low while building muscle
quiz.explain: Lean means muscle with little extra fat.

quiz.q: How often should you check your weight?
quiz.explain: Weekly checks show the trend.

days.title: Stay consistent: the real secret
days.goal: Learn why showing up beats perfect workouts.

video.title: Follow-along leg workout with dumbbells

steps: Train 3 times this week, even if short.
If you miss a day, do a 10-minute version.
Tick off each workout on your calendar.
Write down one reason you keep going.
days.task: Tick off all 3 workouts this week.
days.challenge: Do a 10-minute workout on a busy day.

quiz.q: What matters most for muscle growth?
quiz.explain: Regular training beats rare perfect sessions.

quiz.q: What should you do if you miss a day?
quiz.explain: A short session keeps the habit alive.
Ticks show your streak and keep you proud.

days.title: Train with a partner
days.goal: Work out with a friend and help each other.

video.title: 10 MIN FULL BODY WORKOUT 🔥 For Beginners | No Equipment

steps: Invite a friend to train with you.
Take turns watching form.
Cheer each other on after each set.
Write down what your partner did well.
days.task: Train with a friend this week.
days.challenge: Teach your friend your favourite move.

options: Partners keep you going and make it fun
quiz.explain: A partner adds fun and keeps you honest.

quiz.q: What should you watch in a partner's form?
quiz.explain: Watching form keeps your partner safe.

quiz.q: What should you say after a set?
options: Kind words about what went well
quiz.explain: Kind words keep a partner coming back.

days.title: Eat enough: calories, simply
days.goal: Learn how much food you need to build muscle.

video.title: HWC Beginner Hypertrophy

steps: Eat 3 meals plus a snack each day.
Add a palm-sized protein food to each meal.
Add carbs like rice or yam for energy.
Drink water with your meals.
If you are not gaining, add a little more food each week.
Weigh yourself once a week.
days.task: Add one extra protein food to each meal today.
days.challenge: Eat 3 full meals every day this week.

quiz.q: Why do you need extra food to build muscle?
options: Muscles need fuel and protein to grow
quiz.explain: Muscle is built from the food you eat.

quiz.q: How much protein should a meal have?
quiz.explain: A palm-sized portion is a good guide for most people.

quiz.q: How often should you weigh yourself?
quiz.explain: Once a week shows real change without daily noise.

days.title: Get ready for your capstone
days.goal: Review the whole course and prepare your final project.

video.title: How to Build Muscle as a Beginner | Complete Gym Guide

steps: Read your notes from weeks 1 to 4.
List 5 moves you can now do well.
Practise your capstone workout once.
Write down any questions you still have.
days.task: List 5 moves you can do well now.
days.challenge: Do your capstone workout from memory.

options: A final project that shows what you learned
quiz.explain: The capstone is your final show of skill.

quiz.q: What should you review before the capstone?
options: Your notes from all four weeks
quiz.explain: Reviewing all weeks brings the course together.

quiz.q: How do you know you are ready?
options: You can do a full workout safely from memory
quiz.explain: A full workout done well shows you are ready.

days.title: Final practice day
days.goal: Practise your capstone once more, then rest.

video.title: How to build an amazing physique

steps: Do your capstone workout one more time.
Time each part and check your form.
Fix anything that felt rushed.
Rest well tonight and eat protein.
days.task: Run your capstone workout and time each part.
days.challenge: Fix one thing that felt rushed.

options: Practice makes the real run calm and smooth
quiz.explain: Practice turns worry into calm confidence.

quiz.q: What should you check after practice?
options: Your form, your timing and your breathing
quiz.explain: Checking form and timing makes it smooth.

quiz.q: What should you do the night before?
quiz.explain: Good rest and food help you perform best.

days.title: Capstone day: your muscle workout
days.goal: Show what you learned: do your full muscle workout with good form.

video.title: Push-ups for chest growth

steps: Warm up for 5 minutes.
Do your full workout: 5 moves, good form, steady breathing.
Cool down and stretch for 5 minutes.
Write a short report: what you did and how it felt.
days.task: Complete your capstone workout and write your report.
days.challenge: Hand in your report and celebrate.

quiz.q: What is the first step of your capstone?
quiz.explain: A warm-up gets the body ready and safe.

quiz.q: What matters most in the capstone?
options: Going as fast as you can
quiz.explain: Good form and breathing show real skill.

options: What you did and how it felt
quiz.explain: A short report shows what you learned.

capstone.title: Your full muscle workout
capstone.brief: Perform your own full muscle-building workout from start to finish: warm-up, 5 moves with good form, cool-down, and a short written report.
checks: Did all 5 moves with good form
deliverables: A list of your test numbers
